new_findings.title: Analytics shows $0 per-model breakdown lines for pay-per-token opencode models, while the popover shows the cost opencode recorded
new_findings.detail: mergingOpencode puts `0.0` for every opencode model into modelBreakdownToday/Last7Days (AnalyticsStore.swift:92-93). For a model seen only through opencode on a pay-per-token vendor (e.g. xAI), Analytics lists it at $0.00, but CostFooterView.swift:198-210 shows costLast7DaysByModel (e.g. $7.50) for the same model. README.md:31 says pay-per-token traffic 'shows the cost opencode itself recorded, as a breakdown'. Consider showing tokens only (skip the $0 breakdown entry) or showing the recorded cost as a breakdown that is not added to the total, so the two views agree.
